title: Urine culture
what: Urine is placed in a growth medium to see if germs grow. If they do, the lab checks which antibiotics work on them.
why: For burning and frequent urination, a suspected kidney or bladder infection, during pregnancy, and to check after treatment.
duration: collecting takes a few minutes; results usually take 3 to 7 days
tell_doctor: If you took antibiotics in the last 2 weeks. This can change the result
If you have your period now

prepare.title: Antibiotics
prepare.text: The culture is usually done before you start antibiotics. If you already take them, tell your doctor and they will decide.

prepare.title: Container
prepare.text: Get a sterile container from a pharmacy or your clinic. Do not open it early or touch the inside.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: The first morning urine is best. It usually needs to reach the lab within 1 to 2 hours. Check with your clinic.

steps: In the morning, wash your hands and genitals with water, without antiseptic
Women: cover the vaginal opening with a cotton pad
Let the first small amount go into the toilet
Collect the middle part in the container without touching its edges
Let the rest go into the toilet
Close the lid tightly and label the container
feel: Nothing unpleasant. It is a regular urine collection
after: Take the container to the lab as soon as you can
Until then, keep it in a cool place. Do not freeze it
Show the result with the antibiotic choice to your doctor
red_flags: A fever over 38 degrees with chills and lower back pain
Blood in your urine, severe pain, or you cannot pass urine

faq.q: Why collect the middle part of the urine?
faq.a: The first part has germs from the skin. The middle part is cleaner, so the result is more accurate.

faq.q: Can I do a urine culture while taking antibiotics?
faq.a: You can, but the result may look falsely good. Tell your doctor you are taking them.

reminders.text: Urine culture tomorrow morning. Get a sterile container ready and do not open it early.
